name: Button
purpose: Triggers a user-initiated action with a clear accessible name.
scenarios: Confirm or cancel a reversible action

children.description: Visible label. Prefer text over an unlabeled icon.

onClick.description: Runs after an enabled button is activated by pointer, Enter, or Space.

disabled.description: Prevents interaction while preserving semantic disabled state.

loading.description: Shows a spinner, sets aria-busy, and blocks activation until the request ends.

icon.description: Optional leading visual. Keep a visible text child or pass aria-label.

variant.description: Visual emphasis without changing button semantics.

tone.description: Semantic color. danger is for destructive actions; role stays button.

size.description: Density control. Compact viewports keep a 44px target.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: Controls visual emphasis without changing semantics.

variants.name: tone
variants.description: Semantic color overlay. Does not change the button role.

variants.name: size
variants.description: Controls density while retaining the target-size requirement.

states.name: loading
states.description: Request in flight; activation is blocked.

antiPatterns: Do not use for navigation when a semantic link is appropriate.
Do not hide the accessible name behind an unlabeled icon.

a11y.focus: Shows a visible focus indicator and remains in document order.
a11y.labeling: Has visible text or an explicit accessible name.

responsive.strategy: Keep behavior stable. Compact viewports enforce a 44px minimum target even for size=sm.

breakpoints.medium: Uses content width; sm may be denser.
breakpoints.large: Uses content width; sm may be denser.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Do not mirror label text or symmetric icons.

mechanics: Button is a native <button>. variant, tone, and size are CSS classes; they do not change role. loading sets aria-busy, shows a CSS spinner, and disables activation. disabled sets aria-disabled via the primitive. Compact CSS keeps a 44px minimum target even when size=sm. onClick fires from pointer, Enter, and Space. Use type=submit only inside a Form.
usage: Import Button from @chameleon-ui/components. Pass a visible text child as the accessible name.
Handle activation with onClick. Set type=submit inside Form; keep the default type=button elsewhere.
Use variant=outline or ghost for secondary actions, tone=danger for destructive actions, and loading while a request is in flight.

exports.name: Button
exports.description: Action control with variant, tone, size, loading, icon, type, disabled, and onClick.

exports.name: ButtonProps
exports.description: Extends the primitive button props with variant, tone, size, loading, icon, and className.
